Magical Beast · 12 hexes · SM +5 Behir (Enraged Eggplant; answers SRD 3.5, SRD 5.1)

A serpentine bulk a dozen yards long in cobalt and bronze scale, running on twelve hooked legs that let it climb a cavern wall as easily as cross its floor. It can shed the legs and coil instead, crushing what it has wrapped, and it spits a bolt of lightning down a corridor when coiling is too slow.

Breathe ElectricityBreathe Electricity (14): The behir breathes out a bolt of lightning, dealing thrust 1d+2 burning surge damage (KYOS: 2d+1) as large-area injury. Wearing any metal armor anywhere means having DR 1 against it, if that would be worse for the victim. Anyone wounded must make a HT roll at -1 per 2 HP of injury or be stunned, rolling against HT each turn thereafter to recover. This is a cone attack that uses rules from Area and Spreading Attacks (pp. B413-414). The cone is 1-yard wide and has a length of 7 yards (ST/5). Each use costs 2 FP. Description
Written by Dungeons on Automatic, released under cc_by_4_0
  • GCS ancestry draft: gcs/behir.gct
  • Source template total: 369 points.
  • Library-rebuilt template total: 373 points.
  • CER was computed from parsed Typical Stats using the Dungeons On Automatic baseline CER path.
  • GCS cost adjudication for "FP+4": the source states 8 points and the native GCS library computes 12. Adopted the native library value of 12. Extra Fatigue Points are 3 per point (B16), so FP+4 is 12. The stated 8 prices at 2 per point.
  • CER recomputed from the reviewed Typical Stats through the canonical Dungeons on Automatic CER path: OR 36, PR 39, CER 75, threat tier major.
  • Conversion baseline reported OR 37, PR 39, CER 76 (tier major). The reviewed values come from the consumer CER implementation, which rounds damage once after the damage-type multiplier and credits ranged accuracy; the conversion baseline ceilinged the damage base first and ignored range.
  • Encounter metadata derived (gregarious): average number appearing 1, wandering weight 2. Encounter metadata derived for 0.2.0 from the reviewed threat tier and creature class (appearing: minor 4 / standard 2 / major 1 / severe 1, forced to 1 for solitary classes — including swarms, which are a single multi-body creature — and raised to 6 for gregarious minor creatures; wandering weight: minor 4 / standard 3 / major 2 / severe 1). The fan-conversion source states no appearing-in-numbers or wandering values, so these are derived, not source mechanics.
  • Lair, treasure, and grappling remain unpopulated in 0.2.0 by package policy: the authorized fan-conversion source states no lair, treasure, or grappling values, and review declines to invent them. See review/policy/0.2.0-empty-field-policy.md.
  • Description text is original Dungeons on Automatic prose written from this record's own converted statistics and from the project's art direction for the creature. It is not derived from the authorized fan-conversion source, which states no creature descriptions, and not from any SRD. It carries its own authorship and CC BY 4.0 terms in the description field. See review/policy/description-policy.md.
  • Review approved by automated-mechanical-review on 2026-07-26 (batch ee-2026-07-26-b1-gcs-costs); GCS fidelity check passed, DOA playability check passed.
  • Every exact-identity cost discrepancy on this record is adjudicated against the published GURPS cost table in review/reports/gcs-adjudication.md; the adopted value and its basis are recorded in conversionNotes.
  • Visual GCS verification of the .gct is not claimed by this decision; checks.gcsVisualPass is false.
